improvedVsOld: The new text is clearly better overall. It follows the style guide consistently: 'Gratisplätze' becomes 'kostenlose Stellplätze/Campingplätze', 'Campground' no longer appears in prose, and 'Offline Campingkarte' is gone from the meta keywords. App labels now match the app ('Wunschziele', 'Mit Stern', 'Gefällt mir', 'Umsehen (Look Around)'), and 'Detailseite' replaces 'Ortsseite'. 'Betreiber' becomes 'zuständige Stelle' for land managers, and 'Wohnwagen' replaces 'Caravans'. The calques are fixed ('Nadeln', 'Schilder schlagen Bildschirme', 'Nimm es mit auf die Straße', 'Wie auch immer du unterwegs bist'), the du-imperatives read naturally, and the SEO titles are tighter. Checks: no em dashes or spaced en dashes, no claim that the app is an offline map, and numbers, AUD and brand names are intact. Two regressions: terms 'Geistiges Eigentum' became 'Urheberrecht', and toolsIntro 'Kapazitäten' became 'Tankkapazität', which now suggests a fuel tank. Minor notes that do not fail: ui.metaDescription is about 205 characters, longer than the 140–160 the guide asks for, and 'Preise geprüft am' is followed by an English-format asOf date ('12 August 2026'). That date comes from the code, not the translation.
criticalIssues: Privacy page structure (pre-existing, not introduced by this branch, but this branch rewrites the same keys without fixing it). The German pages.privacy has 6 sections; the English has 7, including the GA4 'Website analytics' section. GA4 is live on main and the German privacy page has no analytics disclosure. The isPageComplete gate in lib/localized.ts stops it publishing in German, so the risk is contained for now. Fix it before the German privacy page is expected to go live.
pages.privacy.sections[3].paragraphs[1] adds a privacy claim that is not in the English source ('keine Werbetracker'). Remove it, since GA4 is now running.
